rows.original_synopsis_draft: With the wormhole inaccessible, Sisko searches for a way to renew contact with Bajor's Prophets.
Odo seeks romantic guidance from a holographic lounge singer as he tries to express his feelings for Kira.
As Kira faces the threatened minefield, Sisko prepares a mission to regain control of Deep Space Nine.
Janeway is left responsible for Q's mischievous, omnipotent son, whose actions cause widespread trouble.
After Voyager becomes trapped inside a living nebula, Janeway leads an effort to repair the damage her ship caused.
A dangerous particle detected near Voyager forces the crew to confront a threat to the surrounding space.
Voyager investigates the destruction of a pre-warp world and the possibility that visiting its recent past caused the disaster.
Voyager's crew discovers that Species 8472 operates a simulation of Starfleet Headquarters.
A young Kazon warrior abducts Chakotay while attempting to prove himself to his people.
Following erratic behavior, Tom Paris abandons Voyager and takes passage with a Talaxian convoy.
The Doctor's growing musical ambitions begin to reshape his relationships and personal life.
An alien seeking refuge aboard Voyager claims to be one of the ship's long-deceased crew members.
Neelix must confront painful memories when the scientist behind the weapon that devastated his homeworld visits Voyager.
Unusual supernovas herald a conflict within the Q Continuum, drawing Voyager into an escalating crisis.
A Hazari ambush leaves Voyager facing an apparently inescapable threat.
